cohort: 41 infants who were admitted to the Istanbul Medipol University breastfeeding counseling clinic between January 2020 and June 2021 and were recommended to be fed with finger feeding
finding: Finger feeding was found to be an effective alternative feeding method for successful breastfeeding.
mod_finding: The finger feeding method was found to be an effective alternative feeding method for successful breastfeeding, regardless of mode of delivery.
